title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for the Survey and Subdivision of All Public Agricultural Lands Lying Parallel To, and Extending Within three Kilometers From, Both Sides of Any Public Highway.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos which shall be spent by the Secretary of Agriculture and
Commerce, upon the recommendation of the Director of Lands, for the survey and subdivision of all public
agricultural lands lying parallel to and at least within three kilometers from both sides of any new public
highway constructed in the Philippines. The lands so surveyed and subdivided shall be open for disposition in
accordance with the terms, limitations, and conditions imposed by the Public, Land Act to all persons
qualified to acquire public lands under said Act, but at least one-half of such lands shall be disposed of only
by means of homestead entry. The expenses of the survey and subdivision shall be apportioned, assessed, and
collected from all applicants, except those for homestead, in addition to the fees, rentals or other payments
collectible under the provisions of said Act, and shall be paid by the respective applicants in ten equal annual
installments without interest from the date of approval of their respective applications.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 12, 1936.
